full_judgment: 2. The case of the plaintiff, in short, is that the Bangladesh Jute Mills Corporation (shortly, the BJMC), a Government owned statutory corporation-opposite party herein as plaintiff instituted Money Suit No. 33 of 2011in the Court of Joint District Judge, Fifth Court, Dhaka on 29-5-2011 praying for a decree a sum of Taka 5,07,35,390.02 (Taka five crore seven lac thirty five thousand three hundred and ninety and two paisa) only against the M/s Nature Bac ('NB' for short) and the defendant-petitioners. The money claimed by the plaintiff-opposite party arises out of a Lease Agreement dated 30-7-2008 entered into between the plaintiff-opposite party as the lessor and M/s Nature Bac a partnership firm as lessee for running MM Jute Mills Limited situated at Sitakund, Chittagong.
